articles.summary: Lumentum thought leaders to discuss innovations in AI interconnects, silicon photonics, VCSELs, and optical networking Lumentum, a global leader in optical and photonic technology, today announced its speaker line-up at the 2026 European Conference on Optical Communications ( ECOC ) in Málaga, Spain. The event will be held from September 20 – 24 at the Trade Fair and Congress Center of Málaga. Visit Lumentum stand #2050. Can Fast Narrow Channels Keep Rising Without Limit or Will Slow and Wide Become the Winner?
